    Get metadata for one vocabulary

    Source: R/api.R
    skosmos_vocabulary.Rd

    Retrieves descriptive metadata for a vocabulary configured in the selected Skosmos installation.

    Usage

    skosmos_vocabulary(client, vocid, lang = NULL)

    Arguments

    client

    A skosmos_client created with skosmos_client().

    vocid

    A single vocabulary identifier, normally taken from the id column returned by skosmos_vocabularies().

    lang

    Optional language code for localized metadata.

    Value

    A tibble containing vocabulary metadata. Nested values are retained as list-columns when necessary.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")
skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")

# Generic discovery pattern.
vocabs <- skosmos_vocabularies(finto, "en")
skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocabs$id[1], "en")
} # }
